name: Reactor Deck
narrativeOnEnter: Red. Everything is red. Emergency lighting, warning strobes, the heat shimmer off the reactor housing. A figure slumped at the control station — Kovalev. Not moving. The reactor sequence panel is unlocked, access code already entered. A safety manual sits open on the console.

action.text:
MERIDIAN STATION — REACTOR SAFETY MANUAL
Section 7: Emergency Stabilisation Sequence

In the event of a thermal runaway warning:
Press the sequence panels in this exact order:

  B → D → A → C → B
  (Panel 2, Panel 4, Panel 1, Panel 3, Panel 2)

This triggers a controlled coolant flush.
Do NOT deviate from this order — incorrect sequence
will accelerate thermal cascade.

Dmitri Kovalev, Chief Engineer. He's alive — barely. Pulse is weak. He inhaled reactor coolant vapour; without a functional med bay, there's nothing you can do for him here.

His hand is resting on the control panel. He got as far as unlocking the sequence before he collapsed.

A scrawled note in his hand:
'Sequence manual — top drawer — B,D,A,C,B — do it in order'

His eyes open briefly. He looks at you. Nods. Closes them again.

The reactor housing is hot — radiating heat even through the shielding. Warning indicators are spiking into the red.

Temperature: 847°C (CRITICAL — threshold 900°C)

You have minutes, not hours. Complete the stabilisation sequence before it cascades.
